subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers be permanently denied access to every legacy ownerless session row, or should OpenClaw provide an explicit operator or Doctor migration/adoption path?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the authority available over persisted pre-ownership rows; tests can verify implementation but cannot choose the intended upgrade trust policy.

options.title: Fail closed with migration
options.body: Reject ownerless rows at runtime while providing and proving an explicit operator or Doctor migration/adoption path.

options.title: Fail closed permanently
options.body: Document that legacy ownerless rows remain manageable only by operators and non-plugin clients.

options.title: Preserve legacy access
options.body: Retain current ownerless-row behavior until a separate ownership migration design is approved.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with migration
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows at runtime while providing and proving an explicit operator or Doctor migration/adoption path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and dominant history connect this owner most strongly to the central Gateway sessions decision surface.
